description: The one-block channel of nhflow_3d_mb_side_edges (hydrostatic): a Riemann edge with a 5 mm tide on x- and a Flather edge on y-, which meet in the corner cell: each edge keeps its ghost depth (iowave::edge_h per side); with one depth per cell the Flather edge overwrote the Riemann depth of the corner and the solution differed from the blocks by 2.6e-4 m of 6e-3 m, now to round-off (validation/13_j_face_zones).
